title: Leverage-Enhanced Sampling Owen Method for Explainable Artificial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.21504v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recently, the Shapley value has been widely applied in machine learning for feature importance analysis and model explainability. The multilinear extension of games proposed by Owen (1972) expresses the Shapley value as the integral of partial derivatives along the main diagonal of the cube. Direct evaluation of this integral requires exponential-time computation of the partial derivatives. To improve computational efficiency, we propose a sampling-based estimation strategy within Owen's multilinear extension framework, combining stratified sampling with coalition leverage scores. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces computational costs while maintaining explanation accuracy.

translated_title: 面向可解释人工智能的杠杆增强采样Owen方法
translated_abstract: 近年来，Shapley值已被广泛应用于机器学习中的特征重要性分析和模型可解释性领域。Owen（1972）提出的博弈多线性扩展将Shapley值表示为沿立方体主对角线的偏导数的积分。直接计算该积分需要对偏导数进行指数级时间的计算。为了提高计算效率，我们在Owen的多线性扩展框架内提出了一种基于采样的估计策略，将分层采样与联盟杠杆分数相结合。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在保持解释准确性的同时显著降低了计算成本。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种在Owen多线性扩展框架内结合分层采样与联盟杠杆分数的采样估计方法，在保持解释准确性的同时显著降低了Shapley值计算的成本。
